scope: Cloudflare control-plane token validation, account catalog lookup, and D1 database catalog lookup only. No D1 SQL, D1 record read, R2 operation, runtime-setting change, Sites access change, or user-data operation was performed.

interpretation.proven: The available protected read-only control-plane credentials were valid for their stated catalog scope. They did not expose a D1 database that could be safely and unambiguously linked to the Sites logical DB binding by the personal-schedule product identifier.
not_proven: The physical D1 identifier behind the current Sites DB binding
interpretation.decision: Do not enumerate arbitrary database schemas or R2 objects. Direct D1/R2 reconciliation remains required only after a Sites-to-physical-binding mapping is made available through an authorized read-only control-plane surface.
